title: A Sign Law for Entropy Drift under Sampler Mismatch in RLVR
abstract: arXiv:2610.34044v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Entropy in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) moves up or down depending on choices that should be neutral, such as whether over-length responses are masked or counted as failures. We trace this to sampler mismatch, where rollouts are drawn with top-k/top-p truncation or at a temperature the learner does not apply, and prove that a constant advantage shift then changes the entropy of a softmax policy, at first order and in expectation, with a sign fixed by the sampler: positive shifts sharpen the policy under any sampler whose likelihood ratio to the policy increases with token probability, including top-k, top-p, min-p, and temperatures below one, and flatten it under flatter samplers. translated_title: RLVR中采样器失配下熵漂移的符号定律
translated_abstract: 在可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，熵的上升或下降取决于一些本应是中性的选择，例如超长响应是被掩蔽还是被计为失败。我们将这一现象追溯到采样器失配——即rollout是用top-k/top-p截断或在学习者并未采用的温度下采样得到的——并证明在此情况下，恒定的优势偏移会在一阶意义和期望意义上改变softmax策略的熵，其符号由采样器固定：在似然比随token概率递增的任何采样器下（包括top-k、top-p、min-p以及低于1的温度），正的优势偏移会使策略变得更尖锐；而在更平坦的采样器下则会使策略变平坦。在采用token级损失的基于分组的RLVR中，这一漂移中受基线控制的部分由token加权的净优势决定，而掩蔽超长响应与将其计为失败会将其推向相反的符号；其余部分则是一个协方差项。
tldr: 本文证明了RLVR训练中熵漂移的符号定律：在似然比随token概率递增的采样器（如top-k、top-p、min-p及低于1的温度）下，正的优势偏移会使策略变尖锐，在更平坦的采样器下则使其变平坦，而掩蔽与计失败超长响应会推动token加权净优势向相反符号变化。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a sign law for entropy drift under sampler mismatch in RLVR: positive advantage shifts sharpen the policy under samplers whose likelihood ratio increases with token probability (including top-k, top-p, min-p, and temperatures below one) and flatten it under flatter samplers, while masking versus failing over-length responses pushes the token-weighted net advantage toward opposite signs.
